golimumab
Approved for rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis and ankylosing spondylitis.
50mg SC QM (Humira q2w, Enbrel qw). IV coming?
NCE? 7,521,206 issued in 2009. ABT suing over 7223394.
Human IGG1 MAB to TNF-alpha. Multiple glycoforms result in weight of 150-151 kD. Binds to soluble and transmembrane TNFa, but does not bind lymphotoxin.
Tmax 2-6 days. Cmax 2.5ug/mL. Limited extravascular distribution. Terminal 1/2 of 2 weeks. Absolute F of 53%. Steady-state at 12 weeks.
Tubercluosis reactivation (0.23/100 patient years incidence in n=2347 phase II/III experience), lymphoma (0.21/100 patient years). Less dropouts than placebo in Phase III experience.
Approved in the US 4/29/09. Submitted MAA in March 2008. Positive CHMP opinion June 2009.
